Get variable labels for FARS and CRSS variables

Source: R/fars_value_labels.R
fars_variables.Rd

fars_variables() returns the variables in each FARS or CRSS data table by year with the variable label and SAS format name from the SAS data files that NHTSA publishes with the zipped SAS data for each year (see data-raw/fars_value_labels.R). Variable labels can change over time and include variables that are not in fars_vars_labels (e.g. variables added in recent years or only used in CRSS).

Usage

fars_variables(
  year = NULL,
  table = NULL,
  variable = NULL,
  source = c("FARS", "CRSS")
)

Arguments

year

One or more years. If NULL (default), returns value labels for all years.

table

One or more FARS or CRSS data table names (e.g. "accident", "person", or "vehicle"). Not case sensitive. If NULL (default), returns value labels for all tables.

variable

One or more variable names (e.g. "INJ_SEV"). Not case sensitive. If NULL (default), returns value labels for all variables.

source

Data source: "FARS" (default) or "CRSS".

Value

A data frame with columns source, year, table, variable, label (the variable label), and format (the SAS format name without the year, or NA for variables without value labels).

Examples

fars_variables(year = 2024, table = "person", variable = c("AGE", "INJ_SEV"))
#>   source year  table variable           label format
#> 1   FARS 2024 person      AGE             Age   AGEF
#> 2   FARS 2024 person  INJ_SEV Injury Severity INJURF
